Generate a 200 word story based on the prompt: "A boy and a cat."

Once upon a time, in a quiet village nestled between green hills, a boy named Leo lived with his grandmother. Every day, he would walk to the edge of the woods, where a patch of mossy stones stood. There, he met a cat named Miso, whose fur shimmered like storm clouds and eyes glowed like embers. Miso didn’t speak, but he understood Leo’s silent language—his gestures, his sighs, the way he pressed his hands to his chest when sad. Together, they explored the forest. Leo taught Miso to jump over fallen logs, and Miso taught Leo to listen to the wind. One autumn evening, as golden leaves danced around them, Leo sat beside Miso and whispered, “I’m scared of the dark.” Miso closed his eyes and rested his head on Leo’s knee. For the first time, Leo didn’t feel afraid. That night, they watched the stars, and Miso purred as if the universe had whispered something comforting. From that day on, Leo knew the forest wasn’t just a place—it was a companion. And Miso, though a cat, was more than a pet. He was a guardian of stillness, a bridge between the human and the natural world. Years later, when Leo grew up, he returned to the woods and found the stones still there, covered in moss. But the cat was gone. Only a small paw print remained—faint, like a memory, like a promise.
